fields.title: Shoppers can use coupon codes at checkout / 用户可以在结算时使用优惠码
fields.how-to-verify:
1. Open Lumen on staging, add any item, go to checkout. / 在预发环境打开 Lumen，加任意商品进入结算。
   **Expect / 预期:** a "Coupon code" field above the total. / 总价上方有「优惠码」输入框。
2. Enter `WELCOME10`. / 输入 `WELCOME10`。
   **Expect / 预期:** the total drops by 10% before you pay. / 付款前总价减少 10%。
3. Refresh the page. / 刷新页面。
   **Expect / 预期:** the code and the discount are still there. / 优惠码和折扣都还在。
4. Enter `EXPIRED`. / 输入 `EXPIRED`。
   **Expect / 预期:** "This code expired on 30 Sep". / 提示「该优惠码已于 9 月 30 日过期」。
fields.evidence:
- Staging run by the agent on 2026-10-17 — all four steps passed. / Agent 于 2026-10-17 在预发环境跑通全部四步。
- Pull requests / PR: [#412](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/412), [#421](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/421)

fields.title: Repeated taps no longer create duplicate orders / 连点提交不再生成重复订单
fields.how-to-verify:
1. On staging, put one item in the cart and tap **Pay** five times quickly. / 在预发环境放一件商品，快速连点五次 **支付**。
   **Expect / 预期:** exactly one order in Order history. / 订单记录里只有一笔订单。
fields.evidence: - Verified on iOS 18 and Android 15 staging builds. / 已在 iOS 18 和 Android 15 预发包验证。
fields.feedback: Checked on both phones. Accepted. / 两台手机都验过，通过。

fields.title: Customers receive itemised PDF invoices / 客户收到含明细的 PDF 发票
fields.how-to-verify:
1. Pay a test order with two items from different tax categories. / 用两种不同税目的商品付一笔测试订单。
   **Expect / 预期:** a PDF invoice appears under the order within a minute. / 一分钟内订单下出现 PDF 发票。
2. Open the PDF. / 打开 PDF。
   **Expect / 预期:** one line per item with its own tax, and the company tax ID in the header. / 每件商品一行并各自列税，页眉有公司税号。
fields.evidence: - Sample invoices for three tax regions attached to [#88](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/88). / 三个税区的样例发票附在 #88。
fields.acceptor: Finance — Olivia Xu / 财务 徐欧

fields.title: Store staff can export orders to CSV / 门店人员可以导出订单 CSV
fields.how-to-verify:
1. In Atlas, filter orders to last week and click **Export CSV**. / 在 Atlas 中筛选上周订单，点 **导出 CSV**。
   **Expect / 预期:** a file with the same row count as the screen. / 文件行数与页面一致。
2. Open it in Excel. / 用 Excel 打开。
   **Expect / 预期:** customer names display correctly. / 客户姓名显示正常。
fields.feedback: Row count is right, but Chinese names are garbled in Excel on Windows. Follow-up task created. / 行数正确，但 Windows 版 Excel 里中文姓名乱码。已建跟进任务。

fields.title: Failed payments are retried automatically / 支付失败会自动重试
Support sees an order status timeline / 客服能看到订单状态时间线
fields.how-to-verify:
1. Open any order that has shipped. / 打开任意已发货订单。
   **Expect / 预期:** a timeline from placed to delivered with times. / 显示从下单到送达、带时间的时间线。
